name: Prerelease CLI

on:
  push:
    branches:

  pull_request:

jobs:
  build-and-test:

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

  prerelease-publish:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && (startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/main') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/prerelease/'))
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Determine prerelease version
        id: version
        run: |
          # Extract version from package.json and append prerelease tag based on branch
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          if [[ $GITHUB_REF == refs/heads/main ]]; then
            PRERELEASE_TAG="alpha.${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          else
            BRANCH_NAME=$(echo $GITHUB_REF | sed 's/refs\/heads\/prerelease\///')
            PRERELEASE_TAG="beta.${BRANCH_NAME}.${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          fi
          NEW_VERSION="${CURRENT_VERSION}-${PRERELEASE_TAG}"
          echo "version=${NEW_VERSION}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Tag: ${PRERELEASE_TAG}"

      - name: Update package.json version
        run: |
          npm version --no-git-tag-version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish --tag prerelease
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

yaml:
name: Prerelease CLI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - prerelease/**
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

  prerelease-publish:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && (startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/main') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/prerelease/'))
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Determine prerelease version
        id: version
        run: |
          # Extract version from package.json and append prerelease tag based on branch
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          if [[ $GITHUB_REF == refs/heads/main ]]; then
            PRERELEASE_TAG="alpha.${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          else
            BRANCH_NAME=$(echo $GITHUB_REF | sed 's/refs\/heads\/prerelease\///')
            PRERELEASE_TAG="beta.${BRANCH_NAME}.${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          fi
          NEW_VERSION="${CURRENT_VERSION}-${PRERELEASE_TAG}"
          echo "version=${NEW_VERSION}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Tag: ${PRERELEASE_TAG}"

      - name: Update package.json version
        run: |
          npm version --no-git-tag-version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish --tag prerelease
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
